title: 第5章 偷吃第6章 逃魂第7章 寻人
slug: 小狐狸的仙教版修行百科
content_zh:
一行人乌压压的进来，堆在院子里，细细打量着。
庭中草木载着晨露，无风自动，伴着阳光映出一片微光，清冷气息随着呼吸钻入肺中，却也不觉寒冷，只感神清气爽。
议论声悄然停息，众人神色肃然，齐刷刷地回头，盯着人群中那位身着青布道袍的道士。
年方弱冠，身形已见挺拔，带着几分未脱的稚气。
“青竹道长，麻烦了。”段勉励看着道长，微微点头。
道长颔首，指挥众人众人各司其职。搭供桌，点明灯，燃线香。实在不知道干什么的，就蹲在地上拔草。
供桌很快搭好，青竹净手，转身取过桌上的一只青瓷水碗，揭开盖。
碗中盛着清晨汲来的清泉水，澄澈见底。
道士端着水碗，缓步走到神像前，垂眸躬身，恭敬地将三支香插入香炉中，待到青烟缠上神像，便神情肃穆地开口：
“青岭山神，敕令暂驻，水为媒介，伏请降临。”
一张符咒从袖口滑出，被指尖捏住。青竹手掌轻轻掠过水面，符咒便溶入水中。
声音回荡在殿中，青竹眉头微颦，碗中水面平静，无牵引神灵之感，不像是自己道力微薄退不了神，倒像是眼前只是个泥塑。
他迟疑一下，仍毕恭毕敬地端着水碗，供在桌上。
“开始祭拜。”
狐狸用幻境隐藏自己，蹲在殿檐上，任凭人在它窝里捣乱，把视线牢牢锁住地上那些竹编食盒。
素衣净面的妇人揭开食盒，香甜气息扑面而来，顶上一层码着整齐的桃酥，金黄酥脆。再掀开第二层，雪白米糕伴着桃花糕，热气腾腾。之后又是第三层……
“哇，好香，哇，这个看起来好吃，哇，还有！声音，这次多亏了你，要是你你也能吃就好了。”声音很少主动说话，只是回答狐的疑问，但从未出过错。要是声音能坐在狐身旁，狐狸一定要狠狠舔它的毛，舔到秃噜为止。
供桌摆的满满当当，段勉励最后伸手，把那整只鸡丢在供桌中心。
狐狸抬起屁股，微弓起身子，随时准备一头钻下去。
道士上前一步，把手里的酒坛打开，洒在地上，朗声道：“山神在上，我等欲修缮此庙，多有叨扰。”

道长率先上了一支香，人群纷纷跟着，挨个祭拜。
毛茸茸的尾巴烦躁地甩来甩去，狐狸吞吐了一夜月光，正是嘴生馋虫的时候，可这些人就是不离开，还有衙役守在供桌前，面容严肃，不知道在防什么。
狐狸耐住性子，等到最后一人也祭拜完。可人群还是没散。
狐狸想起之前听到的话：‘声音，午时是什么意思。’
“午时，曰日中，曰日正，曰亭午，为日悬中天。”
狐狸仰头，拿爪子比划，太阳离中间还差得远呢。
‘之前是狐救了那个叫县令的，这些食物有狐的一份。既然是给狐的，那狐想什么时候吃就什么时候吃！’
狐狸无声抖动尾巴，香味散开，笼罩院落。
狐的手法还不熟练，又是白天，晴光朗朗，院中人头攒动，喧声盈耳，四下视野敞亮。香来自于狐体内，遮住狐本身容易，可要想仅凭这种法子瞒住所有人，无疑痴狐说梦。
道士眸光一凝，倏然抬头，扫视四周。
狐狸不紧不慢，敛息凝神，有意识地将满院香火一一分辨。
‘这缕是那个凶巴巴的，这缕是那只拎食物的……’狐狸拨弄香火，极有分寸的每人只吸一点。
香火的味道或浓或淡，狐又吸了一点，与众人隐晦联系也或深或浅，但也足够了，无形的注视感裹住在场所有人，喧闹声戛然而止。
“山，山神显灵啦！”前排的老者身子一软，噗通一声跪倒在地。此起彼伏的跪倒声接连响起。
content_en:
A group of people came in thickly, piled in the yard, and looked at it carefully.
The grass and trees in the courtyard are carrying morning dew, and there is no wind. With the sunlight reflecting a shimmer, the cool breath penetrates into the lungs with the breath, but I don't feel cold, I just feel refreshed.
The discussion quietly stopped, and everyone looked solemn. They all turned back and stared at the Taoist priest in the crowd who was wearing a green robe.
He is still young, but his figure is already tall and straight, with a bit of childishness still intact.
"Taoist Priest Qingzhu, I'm sorry." Duan Nianli looked at the Taoist Priest and nodded slightly.
The Taoist leader nodded and directed everyone to perform their duties. Set up an offering table, light lamps and burn incense sticks. I really didn’t know what to do, so I squatted on the ground and pulled weeds.
The altar table was quickly set up. Qingzhu cleaned his hands, turned around, took a celadon water bowl from the table, and opened the lid.
The bowl contains clear spring water drawn in the early morning, which is crystal clear.
The Taoist priest held the water bowl, walked slowly to the statue, lowered his eyes and bowed, respectfully inserted the three incense sticks into the incense burner. When the green smoke wrapped around the statue, he spoke solemnly:
"The God of Qingling Mountain has ordered to stay temporarily, and water is the medium to invite him to come."
A charm slipped out of the cuff and was pinched by his fingertips. The palm of the green bamboo brushed gently across the water, and the spell dissolved into the water.
The voice echoed in the hall, Qingzhu frowned slightly, the water in the bowl was calm, and there was no feeling of being pulled by the gods. It was not as if his power was too weak to retreat, but as if he was just a clay sculpture in front of him.
He hesitated for a moment, then still held the water bowl respectfully and placed it on the table.
"Start worshiping."
The fox used the illusion to hide itself, squatting on the eaves of the palace, letting people make trouble in its nest, and keeping its eyes firmly fixed on the bamboo food boxes on the ground.
The woman in plain clothes and clean face opened the food box, and the sweet smell hit her face. There were neatly stacked peach cakes on the top, golden and crispy. Then open the second layer, and the snow-white rice cake is accompanied by peach blossom cake, steaming hot. Then there’s the third floor…
"Wow, it smells so good. Wow, this looks delicious. Wow, also! Voice, it's thanks to you this time. I wish you could eat it too." The voice rarely spoke actively, only answering the fox's questions, but never made a mistake. If the voice could sit next to the fox, the fox would lick its fur until it was bald.
The altar table was full, and Duan Mianli finally reached out and dropped the whole chicken in the center of the altar table.
The fox raised its buttocks and arched its body slightly, ready to dive in at any time.
The Taoist priest stepped forward, opened the wine jar in his hand, sprinkled it on the ground, and said loudly: "The mountain god is above us. We want to repair this temple, but there is a lot of trouble."
The Taoist priest took the lead in offering incense, and the crowd followed and worshiped one by one.
The fluffy tail swung back and forth irritably. The fox had swallowed up the moonlight all night. It was the time when the mouth was full of greedy insects, but these people would not leave. There were also government servants standing guard in front of the altar table with serious faces. I don't know what they were guarding against.
The fox patiently waited until the last person had finished worshiping. But the crowd still didn't disperse.
The fox remembered what he had heard before: ‘Sound, what does noon mean? ’
"At noon, it is said to be at the middle of the day, it is said to be at the middle of the day, it is said to be Pavilion Wu, and it is said to be the sun at the middle of the sky."
The fox raised his head and gestured with his paws. The sun was still far from the center.
‘It was the fox who saved the county magistrate before, and the fox had a share of the food. Since it is for the fox, the fox can eat it whenever he wants! ’
The fox twitched its tail silently, and the scent spread and enveloped the courtyard.
The fox's skills were not yet proficient. It was daytime again, the sun was bright and clear, the courtyard was crowded with people, the noise filled his ears, and his surroundings had a bright view. The fragrance comes from the fox's body, so it is easy to cover the fox itself, but if you want to hide it from everyone just by this method, it is undoubtedly a fox's dream.
The Taoist priest's eyes narrowed, and he suddenly raised his head and glanced around.
The fox took his time, held his breath and concentrated, and consciously distinguished the incense in the courtyard one by one.
"This wisp belongs to the fierce one, and this wisp belongs to the one carrying the food..." The fox fiddled with the incense and carefully inhaled only a little for each person.
the smell of incense orStrong or light, the fox inhaled a little more, and the subtle connection with everyone was also deep or shallow, but it was enough. The invisible sense of attention enveloped everyone present, and the noise stopped abruptly.
"Mountain, the mountain god has appeared!" The old man in the front row softened and fell to his knees with a thud. The sounds of people kneeling down came one after another.
